symptoms.title: Yellowing leaves
symptoms.description: Yellowing commonly begins with older or lower leaves and may gradually become more extensive.

symptoms.title: Brown discoloration
symptoms.description: When the pseudostem is cut, brown or reddish-brown vascular discoloration may be visible inside.

symptoms.title: Wilting and leaf collapse
symptoms.description: Affected leaves may wilt, collapse, and eventually hang downward around the plant.

symptoms.title: Progressive plant decline
symptoms.description: The disease can cause gradual weakening and decline of the banana plant.

treatment.title: Isolate affected plants
treatment.description: Separate affected plants where practical and avoid moving contaminated soil or plant material to healthy areas.

treatment.title: Remove severely affected plants
treatment.description: Where recommended by local agricultural authorities, remove and properly dispose of severely infected plants.

treatment.title: Improve sanitation
treatment.description: Clean and disinfect tools and equipment after working with potentially infected plants.

treatment.title: Avoid unnecessary soil movement
treatment.description: Avoid transferring soil from affected areas to healthy banana-growing areas.

prevention.title: Sanitize tools
prevention.description: Clean and disinfect tools after working with potentially infected plants or soil.

prevention.title: Avoid moving contaminated soil
prevention.description: Contaminated soil can contribute to disease spread, so avoid moving soil from affected areas.

prevention.title: Use healthy planting material
prevention.description: Obtain planting material from reliable sources and avoid using material showing signs of disease.

prevention.title: Limit movement between fields
prevention.description: Reduce unnecessary movement of soil, plant debris, tools, and equipment between affected and healthy areas.
